records.answer_purpose: Explains the $2 CPM flat-fee structure when the creator rejects pure commission and asks for a base rate.

records.content:
Got it—if you'd prefer a flat fee on top of commission, here's how we price:

· We pay $2 CPM based on your avg views on our content (so {avgVV} views ≈ ${avgVV*0.002} per video).
· Per-video cap: 2× your avg views in CPM dollars (caps a blowup at ${avgVV*0.004}).
· Monthly settlement: on the 1st of each month, we tally the total view increment from videos you published the prior month and pay at $2 CPM (subject to the per-video cap above).
· Post more than 3 videos and we'll produce the rest for you—you just publish.

Estimate at this pace: {videoCount} videos × avg ${avgVV*0.002} ≈ {total} as next month's base payout, plus commission on every sale. Deal?

— Linsey
